api_key.description: The API key for authenticating with the Immich server. Can also be set via the `IMMICH_API_KEY` environment variable.

endpoint.description: The full URL of the Immich API endpoint. Can also be set via the `IMMICH_ENDPOINT` environment variable.

block.description: The Immich provider is used to manage resources on an Immich server.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the activity was created.

user_id.description: ID of the user who performed the activity.

block.description: Manages an Immich activity (comment or like).

id.description: Unique identifier for the created notification.

block.description: Sends a system-wide notification as an administrator. Note: This resource triggers a notification upon creation. Deleting the resource will attempt to remove the notification.

album_thumbnail_asset_id.description: ID of the asset used as the album's thumbnail.

asset_ids.description: List of asset IDs to include in the album.

is_activity_enabled.description: Whether user activity (comments/likes) is enabled for this album.

order.description: Sort order for assets in the album. Must be either `asc` or `desc`.

role.description: Role granted to the user. Must be either `Editor` or `Viewer`.

user_id.description: Unique identifier of the user to share with.

users.description: List of users to share the album with.

block.description: Manages an Immich album.

id.description: Unique identifier for the API key.

name.description: Display name for the API key.

permissions.description: List of permissions granted to this API key (e.g. `asset.read`, `asset.upload`).

secret.description: The generated API key secret. This value is only returned when the key is created.

block.description: Manages an Immich personal API key. Note that the secret is only available upon creation.

device_asset_id.description: Unique identifier for the asset on the device. Defaults to the filename.

device_id.description: Unique identifier for the device/client. Defaults to 'terraform'.

file_created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the file was created. Defaults to the current time.

file_modified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the file was last modified. Defaults to the current time.

filename.description: Path to the local file to upload. If provided, the asset will be uploaded to Immich.

id.description: Unique identifier for the asset. If filename is provided, this is computed after upload.

is_favorite.description: Whether the asset is marked as a favorite.

block.description: Manages an Immich asset. Supports uploading a file or managing metadata of an existing asset.

asset_id.description: The ID of the asset this face belongs to.

bounding_box_x1.description: The left coordinate of the bounding box.

bounding_box_x2.description: The right coordinate of the bounding box.

bounding_box_y1.description: The top coordinate of the bounding box.

bounding_box_y2.description: The bottom coordinate of the bounding box.

image_height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

image_width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

person_id.description: The ID of the person associated with this face.

block.description: Manages an Immich face (detected or manual).

asset_count.description: Number of assets currently in the library.

exclusion_patterns.description: List of glob patterns to exclude from import.

import_paths.description: List of filesystem paths to import assets from (required for `EXTERNAL` libraries).

is_visible.description: Whether the library is visible in the UI.

owner_id.description: Unique identifier of the library owner.

type.description: Type of the library. Must be either `UPLOAD` or `EXTERNAL`.

block.description: Manages an Immich library.

is_saved.description: Whether the memory is saved by the user.

block.description: Manages an Immich memory.

in_timeline.description: Whether the partner's assets should appear in your timeline.

partner_id.description: The ID of the user to partner with.

block.description: Manages an Immich partner connection.

is_favorite.description: Whether the person is marked as a favorite.

is_hidden.description: Whether the person is hidden from the UI.

block.description: Manages an Immich person. Note: Persons are usually created automatically by Immich facial recognition. This resource can be used to update their details or manually create a new person.

album_id.description: ID of the album to share (required if type is `ALBUM`).

allow_download.description: Whether to allow users with the link to download assets.

allow_upload.description: Whether to allow users with the link to upload assets.

asset_ids.description: List of asset IDs to share (required if type is `INDIVIDUAL`).

description.description: Optional description for the shared link.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp when the link expires.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shared link.

key.description: The encryption key for the shared link.

password.description: Optional password protection for the link.

show_metadata.description: Whether to show asset metadata to users with the link.

slug.description: Custom URL slug for the shared link.

type.description: Type of the shared link. Must be either `ALBUM` or `INDIVIDUAL`.

block.description: Manages an Immich shared link for albums or individual assets.

asset_ids.description: List of asset IDs to include in the stack. The first ID will be the primary asset by default.

primary_asset_id.description: The ID of the primary asset in the stack.

block.description: Manages an Immich asset stack.

id.description: Virtual identifier for the singleton resource.

url.description: URL of the machine learning server.

ignore_cert.description: Whether to ignore certificate validation errors.

default_storage_quota.description: Default storage quota for new users in bytes.

block.description: Manages Immich system configuration. This is a singleton resource.

type.description: Type of the tag (OBJECT or USER).

block.description: Manages an Immich tag.

email.description: Email address of the user. This is used for login.

is_admin.description: Whether the user has administrative privileges.

password.description: Initial password for the user. Only used during creation or when forced by `should_change_password`.

quota_size_in_bytes.description: Maximum storage quota for the user in bytes. Set to 0 or null for unlimited.

should_change_password.description: Force the user to change their password on next login.

storage_label.description: Label used for the user's storage path.

block.description: Manages an Immich user account.

actions.description: JSON string representing the workflow actions.

filters.description: JSON string representing the workflow filters.

triggers.description: JSON string representing the workflow triggers.

block.description: Manages an Immich workflow (Experimental).

user_id.description: ID of the user who performed the activity.

asset_count.description: Number of assets in the album.

is_favorite.description: Whether the asset is a favorite.

assets.description: List of assets matching the criteria.

type.description: Filter by asset type (IMAGE or VIDEO).

bounding_box_x2.description: The right coordinate of the bounding box.

bounding_box_y1.description: The top coordinate of the bounding box.

bounding_box_y2.description: The bottom coordinate of the bounding box.

image_height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

image_width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

person_id.description: The ID of the person associated with this face.

block.description: Retrieves a list of faces for a specific asset.

owner_id.description: Unique identifier of the library owner.

type.description: Type of the library (UPLOAD or EXTERNAL).
